notes: Kyushu's graduate schools publish eligibility, English scores and application dates almost only in PDF guidelines (Engineering, ISEE, Economics, Design, Agriculture, Science, Mathematics, Automotive Science, ISGS), which the snapshot tool cannot read, so those programmes carry few or no values. Only the Law programmes (LL.M., YLP, BiP) state eligibility and TOEFL in HTML. Application periods found in HTML (ISEE, Economics, Design, ISGS, IMAP, Medical) are either closed or lack a year, so no deadline was recorded. Doctoral-only, Japanese-taught and Medical Sciences (Japanese-only master's) programmes were skipped; Pharmaceutical Sciences, Dental Science master's, Systems Life Sciences, Interdisciplinary Engineering Sciences and the Educational Studies MA course were not reached.
